text_block_list.text:
Today marks the start of the "Summer 
Training Camp." Intensive training begins 
to hone our skills—
Or so it was supposed to be.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Listen, Guinea Pig-kun! There are 
countless experiments that can only be 
done in the summer!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Don't let the heat get to you; brace 
yourself and be a proper guinea pig!
choice_data_list:
This is *your* "Summer Training Camp," you 
know!?
It's your Summer Training Camp, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Full-grown adults shouldn't fret over 
trivial things. Come, let's enjoy the 
summer!

—And so, a summer training camp filled 
with turbulence alongside Agnes Tachyon 
has begun!
